## ec65f8d7bf45

**Suspected shortcut / domain question, not a generated invalidity.** The rule
selects the singleton paint color by frequency and works when that singleton is
away from a canvas corner. However, all five canonical demonstrations and the
assigned generator domain require the singleton marker to occupy a corner.
Therefore the rival “perform the checker fill only when the singleton is in a
canvas corner; otherwise return the input unchanged” fits all public pairs and
all emitted inputs.

An exact 8×9 off-corner input places the singleton color `3` at `(0,4)` and a
color-5 rectangular frame at rows 2..6, columns 2..7. The selected Racket
authority hash `7cc365f60685` fills the frame interior with the checker pattern;
the corner-only rival returns the input unchanged. The target `self_check`
rejects this witness with `the paint marker must occupy a canvas corner`, and the
generator does not emit it, so this is a curriculum restriction/shortcut rather
than a reproduced generated-domain error.

Evidence and exact supported command are retained in
`checks/audit/ec65f8d7bf45/counterexample.json` and
`checks/audit/ec65f8d7bf45/racket.json`. The audit target was not modified.
